evidence: Homepage lists 6 templates, each card shows author (e.g. Sarah Chen), description, category/scenario tags, uses count, and updated date.
Clicking 'Use Template' on Professional Resume opened a dialog with the selected template's fill form.
Filled all Professional Resume form fields (Full Name, Job Title, Email, etc.) successfully via textboxes.
After filling required fields, 'Preview Result' tab became enabled and displayed formatted rendering of the filled data.
Each template card shows name (heading), author, description, type tag (category/scenario), and 'Updated <date>'.

issue: Markdown output has formatting defect when optional field is empty
actual: When End Date was left empty, the preview rendered the literal text '*Jan 2020 - *' (unprocessed asterisks) instead of italicized 'Jan 2020 - ' or omitting the trailing dash, indicating the generated Markdown is not always valid/consistent with expected rendering.

evidence: With 'Skills' field empty, the 'Preview Result' tab remained disabled and a banner read 'Required fields missing / Please fill in: Skills'.
A visible alert banner 'Required fields missing / Please fill in: Skills' appeared while required fields were incomplete, and disappeared once all required fields were filled.

actual: Typed 'JavaScript ￥#@%^*' into the Skills field; all special characters were accepted without filtering, no warning/error message was shown, and the field allowed the form to become valid for preview.

issue: No visual feedback for special character input
actual: After entering special characters (￥#@%^*) into the Skills field, no visual indication (error border, message, or blocked input) was shown; characters were accepted silently.

With End Date left blank, the Experience date line rendered as literal '*Jan 2020 - *' (raw asterisks visible) rather than properly formatted italic text, i.e. a formatting error in the generated content.

evidence: 'Copy to Clipboard' button is present in Preview Result tab; clicking it produced no console errors (clipboard read-back blocked by browser permission, but write call executed without failure).

actual: Entered 'not-a-date' into the required 'Start Date' field; form accepted it, Preview tab enabled, and preview rendered 'not-a-date - 2019' without any validation error.
Entered Start Date 'not-a-date' and End Date '2019' (chronologically before/inconsistent with start); no validation error was raised and preview generated successfully with 'not-a-date - 2019'.

evidence: Submit Template dialog allows Title, Author, Description, Category, Scenario, Markdown content, and custom fields; submission succeeded with toast 'Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library.'
After submitting 'QA Test Template', it immediately appeared as a new card in the main library grid ('Showing 7 of 7 templates') and was clickable/usable like other templates.
Template count updated from 6 to 7 immediately after submission without page reload, and the new 'QA Test Template' card displayed correct author, description, and 'Updated 2026-09-02'.
Clicking Submit with empty Title/Author/Description/Content fields produced toast 'Missing required fields / Please fill in all required fields.' and did not create a template.

issue: No Markdown syntax validation on submission
actual: Submitted template content containing an unclosed code fence, an unclosed markdown link, and unclosed bold markers; the app accepted it without any syntax warning. On preview, this malformed content caused broken rendering: the {{title}} placeholder was left unreplaced, the intended heading/paragraph text collapsed into a single garbled inline-code block ('unclosed code block [bad link]( **unclosed bold Hello'), and the {{name}} field placeholder vanished — a clear rendering error that should have been caught before submission.

evidence: Category filter (Resume -> 'Showing 1 of 6'), Scenario filter (Academic -> 'Showing 1 of 6'), and Sort By (Most Popular default order 1250>1100>890>720>560>340 uses; Recently Updated reordered to 2024-12-05..2024-09-30) all worked correctly.
Typing 'resu' into the search box immediately filtered the grid to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' (Professional Resume) without needing to submit/press enter.
Typing partial keyword 'resu' (fuzzy, not exact) matched and filtered to 'Professional Resume', and a suggestion dropdown button appeared below the search box.

issue: Suggestion click does not redirect to the template
actual: Typing 'resu' showed a 'Professional Resume' suggestion button; clicking it only auto-filled the search box with the full title and kept the user on the filtered list view. It did not redirect/open the corresponding template's fill/preview dialog as expected.

evidence: Clicking the heart icon on 'Professional Resume' toggled it to a filled/highlighted state and the header 'Favorites' button badge incremented to '1'.

Clicking 'Favorites' switched the grid to show only the favorited template ('Showing 1 of 6 templates': Professional Resume); typing 'Resume' in the search box while in Favorites view continued to correctly filter within the favorites list.

After clicking the favorite (heart) button, its DOM classes changed to add 'bg-primary/10 text-primary' and the heart icon gained 'fill-current', visually indicating the favorited state; the header badge count also updated in real time.
